Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XXIV OF 1985
ORDINANCE XXIV OF
1985
REPRESENTATION OF
THE PEOPLE (SEVENTH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1985
An Ordinance
further to amend the Representation of the People Act, 1976
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 1, 17th March, 1985]
No. F. 17 (1) 85-Pub.-The following
Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general information :--
1. Short title and commencement.-- (1) This Ordinance may be called . the Representation of the People
(Seventh Amendment) Ordinance, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
